claim.text: The proposed L17 contextual calculus reaches three two-layer excursions in a bounded conditional blank-orbit continuation; a new context-preserving nesting identity has a read-window induction and bounded raw checks.
claim.scope: 673467 conditional contextual rewrites including the supplied 2000-prefix, full time/head totals through 230000, independent state replay from 100000 through 673467; 268 nesting endpoints, 80 windows, 128 compiler comparison requests, 12 ACAF mutants and 12 unit methods.
assumptions: Incoming blank reachability to C(6575648756,1) is supplied by Claude; no private repo or Lean build inspected here.
Contextual F100/F111/F1100 and short-case universal interpretation uses the delivered mathematical derivations; not newly Lean formalized.
Exact literal TM semantics: undefined F1 halts without an action, blank 0, head at first displayed cell.
Local protocols precede their respective validation phases, after disclosed exploration; not externally authenticated preregistration.
forbidden_promotions: No new Lean theorem, halting or non-halting theorem, or certified Cryptid.
A finite depth record is neither a universal bound nor unboundedness.
A uniform one-layer push on the U-input family does not iterate on the different T-output family.
Block depth alone is not a counter-encoding lower bound.
State-only phases do not provide accumulated raw-time/head certificates.

specification.intended_object: Complete contextual tape endpoints, bounded conditional trajectory, and a universally quantified nesting identity with explicit proof windows.
invariants: Only exterior trailing zeros may be omitted.
The explicit 00 before v in NEST is required and v is never read.
Pure-tail depth is determined from actual word structure, not chunk count.
Unknown prefixes, guards and wall-budget stops remain explicit.
known_answer_cases: NEST(n=0) agrees with the old C(a,1) base.
C(7,1).U^2 reaches C(0,2).T^3 in 226 steps, head shift -2.
The first F1100 source has A divisible by 3 and canonical tail width 76.

preregistration.prediction: Separate local protocols register 100000 full rewrites, later state-only discovery, full replay, deeper wall-budget search and nesting checks. Later phases are explicitly subsequent experiments after earlier stops.
preregistration.primary_metric: Exact complete words and guards; full counts/shifts only in full-time phases; fixed-window confinement and raw endpoint agreement for NEST.
preregistration.uncertainty_method: Exact finite comparisons and a mathematical induction; no p-value or asymptotic confidence claim.
preregistration.kill_condition: Any discrepancy stops that phase and is retained before correction.
preregistration.stop_condition: Discovery horizons 100000 then up to 1000000 global rewrites with explicit time/bit caps; deeper phase stops at 673467 on its 180-second cap. Raw probes never extend a failing horizon.
preregistration.promotion_rule: Lean formalization and connection to the supplied blank entry are needed for new Lean reachability; an invariant or explicit infinite argument is needed for a global stack claim.
